block.guhs.kruimelkwal_pot.lore: A Crumb Jelly in a jar: it gives light. Break the jar and it floats free again.
item.guhs.leegteparel.lore: A thank-you from the Void Whale Guh. Hold it to your ear and you can hear it sing.

gui.guhs.einde2_zwevers.walvis.morgen: Yum, sings the whale. You already have today's pearl: come back tomorrow, nyeg.

gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.kruimelkwal: Rarity: In swarms in the Crumb Clouds
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.kruimelkwal: A little jellyfish of glowing cheese crumbs that drifts through the Crumb Clouds in swarms. It weighs nothing, doesn't sting, and is secretly a trampoline: drop onto one and BOING, you bounce five blocks straight up (sneak, and you sink gently through). After a bounce, landing doesn't hurt. Scoop one up with a glass bottle and you have a Crumb Jelly Jar: the coziest lamp in the Guh End. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.leegtewalvisguh: Rarity: Legendary, between the outer islands (only for those who believe the captain)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.leegtewalvisguh: Huge, slow and chonkily content, it floats between the islands, singing so low that your nibbles tremble. Nibble Chorus grows on its back, and there is plenty of room to land and float along for a while. Feed it a Nibble Chorus Fruit and it thanks you with a Void Pearl (one a day, it is thrifty). You don't put an island on a lead, but whoever believes the old captain in the harbor pub and feeds a whale often gets one of their own: a flying home with a little house on its back.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.vleermuis_lemurgu: Rarity: Rare in the Crumb Clouds (and at the air temples)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.vleermuis_lemurguh: Half bat, half lemur, all guh: enormous ears, a ringed tail and little skin wings. It flutters from spot to spot in short hops and likes nothing better than napping upside down from a ceiling, wings wrapped around itself like a blanket. Sneak, and it sleeps on. Crazy about fruit: an apple, berries or a Nibble Chorus Fruit. Mind your nibbles, say the monks. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.otter_pinguinguh: Rarity: Rare on the Blue Cheese Plains (and at the Water Tribe)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.otter_pinguinguh: A penguin's body with an otter's snout, whiskers and four flippers. Walking is a waddle, but on ice and snow it flops onto its belly and slides away. At the Water Tribe you may sit on one: sledding on an Otter-Penguin Guh! Steer by looking, push off with forward, brake with back. It enjoys it most of all itself. Likes a little fish.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.das_molguh: Rarity: Rare in the Crystal Cheese Cliffs (and at Omashguh)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.das_molguh: A low brown digger with a badger's stripe and hefty claws. It is blind and keeps its little eyes comfortably shut, but it feels every step you take: walk past and it pokes its snout your way, sniffing (sneak, and it notices nothing). In soft ground it digs itself in and tunnels around with only a strip of back above the ground. It never leaves a hole: everything lies neatly in place afterwards. The first earthbenders, they say in Omashguh. Crazy about cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.schildpad_eendguh: Rarity: Rare in the Nibble Chorus Forest (and on the palace pond)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.schildpad_eendguh: A yellow duckling in a green turtle shell. It bobs on the water, waddles to the nearest pond when it is on dry land, and tucks itself into its shell for a moment when startled. Hold a piece of bread and it follows you everywhere; every bite is a contented quack-nyeg. In the Fire Nation even the grumpiest prince secretly feeds them.
